category_title: Student with developmental delay and learning disabilities exhibiting disruptive behaviors and repetitive questioning
minimal_context: Dang is working independently in the classroom on a handwriting task where she needs to draw a picture and label it with a short sentence.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please draw a picture and then label it with a short sentence.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Spends time drawing and colouring the picture)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Looks good. Now please write the short sentence.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Begins labelling the drawing with a short sentence)

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Forms the letters the wrong way round)

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Please draw a picture and then label it with a short sentence.

STUDENT: (Spends time drawing and colouring the picture)

TUTOR: Looks good. Now please write the short sentence.

STUDENT: (Begins labelling the drawing with a short sentence)

TUTOR: Keep writing your letters.

STUDENT: (Forms the letters the wrong way round)
